in_hebrew.name: Erminna
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, Ermos + Nymphe, Nymph
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Erminna הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Erminna is derived from the Greek words 'Ermos' meaning strong and 'Nymphe' meaning nymph. In Greek mythology, nymphs were supernatural beings associated with nature, fertility, and water. Erminna embodies the strength and grace of these divine beings.
